name: NewsAPI.org
rate_limits: 100 requests/day on free tier; articles have 24-hour delay; search limited to 1 month history
notes: One of the most popular news APIs. Free tier is development/testing only — cannot be used in production. CORS enabled only for localhost. Covers 150,000+ sources in 14 languages across 55 countries. Endpoints: /top-headlines (breaking news by country/category), /everything (full article search), /sources (available publishers). Useful for AI because it provides structured metadata, source info, and content snippets in a consistent JSON format.
